keyword: was there a rocket launch today
claims: Multiple SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket launches occurred on Tuesday, April 14, 2026.
A Falcon 9 launched at 5:33 a.m. ET from Cape Canaveral Space Force Station, Florida, on April 14, 2026.
The Falcon 9 launch from Cape Canaveral Space Force Station, Florida, at 5:33 a.m. ET on April 14, 2026 carried 29 Starlink satellites.
A Falcon 9 was scheduled to launch from Vandenberg Space Force Base, California, at 7:40 p.m. PT on April 14, 2026.
7:40 p.m. PT on April 14, 2026 is 4:29 UTC on April 15.
The Falcon 9 launch scheduled from Vandenberg Space Force Base, California, at 7:40 p.m. PT on April 14, 2026 was to carry 25 Starlink satellites.
The Falcon 9 launch from Cape Canaveral Space Force Station, Florida, at 5:33 a.m. ET on April 14, 2026 was visible along parts of the East Coast.
The Falcon 9 launch from Cape Canaveral Space Force Station, Florida, at 5:33 a.m. ET on April 14, 2026 sometimes created a "jellyfish" effect in the sky.
